messages:
lucy: Hey — flagging a billing / credits mismatch. Our dashboard shows ~8.6k free-tier tokens remaining but the invoice for last period shows no free credits applied and we were billed. Invoice ID inv_01Gxxxx, sample request id req_9a8b7c. Anyone seen free_pool get ignored like this? :confused:

devon: Can you paste the org_id and the exact time window? Also which view shows 8.6k (Console -> Billing -> Free pool) vs where invoice shows 0? :eyes:

lucy: org: org_5382, window: 2026-03-08 00:00 -> 2026-03-09 00:00 UTC. Console -> Billing -> Free pool shows "Remaining: 8,640 tokens". Invoice CSV attached shows free_pool_applied = 0 for that period. req_9a8b7c corresponds to a chat completion around 2026-03-08T12:14:22Z.

billing-bot: Automated ledger export (excerpt):
```
org: org_5382
2026-03-08T00:00:00Z free_pool_balance: 8640
2026-03-08T12:14:22Z usage_record req_9a8b7c tokens: 420 charge_type: paid
2026-03-09T00:00:00Z free_pool_balance: 0
```

rahul: Quick hypothesis: looks like a mis-ordered job run — the free_pool backfill job may have updated the Console balance after the invoice generation job ran. Two possible races: 1) meter -> invoice job runs before free_pool debit reconciler, 2) cache TTL on pricing view shows stale value. Can you run a quick check on metering logs for that request id? Example query I used: `service=metering request_id=req_9a8b7c`

lucy: ran the query, got this snippet: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-08T12:14:22Z","request_id":"req_9a8b7c","org":"org_5382","tokens":420,"applied_credit_type":"none","billing_note":"metered as paid"}
```
So metering shows no free credit applied. But Console shows free pool balance prior to that time.

rahul: OK that aligns with the race theory. Two remediation paths: 1) short term manual credit/refund for the affected invoice and mark it as not billable (support action), 2) longer term: change job ordering or add a reconciliation pass that runs before invoice generation to ensure free_pool debits are applied to usage records. I'll open an eng issue.

tia: For immediate customer impact, I can issue a manual credit equal to the tokens billed (420 tokens -> refund in USD) and flag invoice inv_01Gxxxx for adjustment. Please confirm amount and that you want a refund vs. account credit. :clipboard:

devon: Please create an internal ticket and tag billing-engine + metering. Rahul, can you include repro steps and the log snippets above? I'll attach the invoice and the console screenshot posted by Lucy.

rahul: Will do. Repro steps (short): 1) create test org with free_pool balance X, 2) trigger high-frequency requests around invoice cutoff, 3) force meter job to run before free_pool reconciler (set JOB_ORDER env to old-default) -> observe usage_record.applied_credit_type is none while console shows free_pool still present. Attaching a small script in ticket.

lucy: Thanks — please escalate, we have a customer on the line. Confirming refund is fine, account credit preferred. :thumbsup:

devon: Created INC-2026-459 in internal tracker, assigned to billing-engine & metering, priority P1 for revenue-impact. Tia can process the credit once billing confirms amount.

lucy: Appreciate it. If you need anything else from me I can share more request ids.

rahul: Adding note: also check for off-by-one in TTL when migrating free_pool rows between redis and postgres — seen that bite before.

billing-bot: Action log: INC-2026-459 created, invoice adj pending, notification sent to billing-engine.

lucy: Thanks all :heart:
